import csv, statistics

rows = list(csv.DictReader(open('eu_economic_data.csv')))
countries = [r for r in rows if r['Country'] != 'EU_Total']
eu = [r for r in rows if r['Country'] == 'EU_Total']

def f(r, k): return float(r[k])

# EU totals
print("=== EU TOTAL ===")
for r in eu:
    print(r['Year'], "GDP growth:", r['GDP_Growth_Pct'], "| Inflation:", r['Inflation_Pct'],
          "| Unemp:", r['Unemployment_Pct'], "| Trade bal:", r['Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR'],
          "| Debt:", r['Public_Debt_Pct_GDP'])

print("\n=== 2024 country rankings ===")
c24 = sorted([r for r in countries if r['Year']=='2024'], key=lambda r: f(r,'GDP_Growth_Pct'), reverse=True)
print("GDP growth 2024:", [(r['Country'], r['GDP_Growth_Pct']) for r in c24])
c24 = sorted([r for r in countries if r['Year']=='2024'], key=lambda r: f(r,'Unemployment_Pct'))
print("Unemployment 2024:", [(r['Country'], r['Unemployment_Pct']) for r in c24])
c24 = sorted([r for r in countries if r['Year']=='2024'], key=lambda r: f(r,'Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR'), reverse=True)
print("Trade balance 2024:", [(r['Country'], r['Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR']) for r in c24])
c24 = sorted([r for r in countries if r['Year']=='2024'], key=lambda r: f(r,'Public_Debt_Pct_GDP'), reverse=True)
print("Debt/GDP 2024:", [(r['Country'], r['Public_Debt_Pct_GDP']) for r in c24])

print("\n=== 2022 vs 2024 changes ===")
for c in sorted(set(r['Country'] for r in countries)):
    r22 = [r for r in countries if r['Country']==c and r['Year']=='2022'][0]
    r24 = [r for r in countries if r['Country']==c and r['Year']=='2024'][0]
    print(f"{c:12s} growth {r22['GDP_Growth_Pct']}->{r24['GDP_Growth_Pct']} | inflation {r22['Inflation_Pct']}->{r24['Inflation_Pct']} | unemp {r22['Unemployment_Pct']}->{r24['Unemployment_Pct']} | trade {r22['Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR']}->{r24['Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR']} | debt {r22['Public_Debt_Pct_GDP']}->{r24['Public_Debt_Pct_GDP']}")

print("\n=== 2024 EU composition ===")
total_gdp = sum(f(r,'GDP_Billion_EUR') for r in countries if r['Year']=='2024')
for r in sorted([r for r in countries if r['Year']=='2024'], key=lambda r: -f(r,'GDP_Billion_EUR')):
    print(f"{r['Country']:12s} GDP {r['GDP_Billion_EUR']:>8}  ({100*f(r,'GDP_Billion_EUR')/total_gdp:.1f}% of sample)")

print("\n=== averages ===")
for metric in ['GDP_Growth_Pct','Unemployment_Pct','Inflation_Pct','Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR','Public_Debt_Pct_GDP']:
    vals22 = [f(r,metric) for r in countries if r['Year']=='2022']
    vals24 = [f(r,metric) for r in countries if r['Year']=='2024']
    print(f"{metric:30s} avg22={statistics.mean(vals22):.2f}  avg24={statistics.mean(vals24):.2f}")

# GDP change total
g22 = sum(f(r,'GDP_Billion_EUR') for r in countries if r['Year']=='2022')
g24 = sum(f(r,'GDP_Billion_EUR') for r in countries if r['Year']=='2024')
print(f"\nSample GDP 2022: {g22:.0f}B -> 2024: {g24:.0f}B (+{(g24-g22)/g22*100:.1f}%)")

import csv
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

rows = list(csv.DictReader(open('eu_economic_data.csv')))
def f(r,k): return float(r[k])
eu = [r for r in rows if r['Country']=='EU_Total']
countries = [r for r in rows if r['Country']!='EU_Total']
years = ['2022','2023','2024']
EU_BLUE='#1f4e79'; ACCENT='#E63946'; GREEN='#2a9d8f'; GRAY='#8d99ae'

# Chart 1: EU Inflation vs Growth - "The Soft Landing"
fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5))
x = np.arange(3)
inf = [f(r,'Inflation_Pct') for r in eu]; gr = [f(r,'GDP_Growth_Pct') for r in eu]
ax1.plot(x, inf, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, color=ACCENT, label='Inflation (%)')
ax1.plot(x, gr, marker='s', linewidth=2.5, color=EU_BLUE, label='GDP Growth (%)')
ax1.axhline(2.0, color=GREEN, linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, label='ECB 2% target')
ax1.set_xticks(x); ax1.set_xticklabels(years)
ax1.set_ylabel('Percent (%)'); ax1.set_ylim(-1, 11)
ax1.set_title('Europe\'s Soft Landing: Inflation Tamed, Growth Held', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.annotate('Inflation shock\n(energy crisis)', xy=(0,9.2), xytext=(0.15,10.1), fontsize=9, color=ACCENT,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=ACCENT))
ax1.annotate('Back to target', xy=(2,2.4), xytext=(1.45,0.6), fontsize=9, color=GREEN,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=GREEN))
ax1.annotate('Growth scare: 0.4%', xy=(1,0.4), xytext=(1.15,3.4), fontsize=9, color=EU_BLUE,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=EU_BLUE))
ax1.legend(loc='upper right'); ax1.grid(alpha=0.25)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('chart1_soft_landing.png', dpi=150); plt.close()

# Chart 2: 2024 GDP growth by country - divergence story
c24 = sorted([r for r in countries if r['Year']=='2024'], key=lambda r: f(r,'GDP_Growth_Pct'))
names = [r['Country'] for r in c24]; vals = [f(r,'GDP_Growth_Pct') for r in c24]
colors = [GREEN if v>1.5 else (GRAY if v>=0 else ACCENT) for v in vals]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5))
bars = ax.barh(names, vals, color=colors, edgecolor='white')
ax.axvline(0, color='black', linewidth=0.8)
ax.axvline(1.0, color=GREEN, linestyle='--', linewidth=1, label='EU average 0.9%')
for b,v in zip(bars, vals):
    ax.text(v+0.06 if v>=0 else v-0.06, b.get_y()+b.get_height()/2, f'{v:+.1f}%', va='center',
            ha='left' if v>=0 else 'right', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('2024: The Two-Speed Europe', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('GDP Growth (%)')
ax.set_xlim(-0.8, 4.2)
ax.legend(loc='lower right'); ax.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.25)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('chart2_two_speed_europe.png', dpi=150); plt.close()

# Chart 3: Trade balance evolution - rebalancing story
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5))
x = np.arange(3)
for c in ['Germany','France','Italy','Spain','Netherlands','Poland','Sweden']:
    vals = [f(r,'Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR') for r in countries if r['Country']==c]
    ax.plot(x, vals, marker='o', linewidth=2, label=c)
ax.plot(x, [f(r,'Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR') for r in eu], marker='D', linewidth=3, color='black', label='EU Total')
ax.axhline(0, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=1)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(years)
ax.set_ylabel('Trade Balance (Billion EUR)')
ax.set_title('The Great Rebalancing: From -198B to -8B', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax.legend(ncol=3, fontsize=8, loc='upper center'); ax.grid(alpha=0.25)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('chart3_trade_rebalancing.png', dpi=150); plt.close()

# Chart 4: Inflation by country 2022 vs 2024 - disinflation champion
c22 = {r['Country']: f(r,'Inflation_Pct') for r in countries if r['Year']=='2022'}
c24 = {r['Country']: f(r,'Inflation_Pct') for r in countries if r['Year']=='2024'}
names = sorted(c22.keys(), key=lambda c: c22[c]-c24[c], reverse=True)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5))
y = np.arange(len(names)); h=0.35
ax.barh(y+h/2, [c22[c] for c in names], height=h, color='#E6A8A8', label='2022 Inflation')
ax.barh(y-h/2, [c24[c] for c in names], height=h, color=GREEN, label='2024 Inflation')
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(names)
ax.axvline(2.0, color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=1)
ax.set_xlabel('Inflation (%)')
ax.set_title('Disinflation Champions: From Double Digits to Target', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax.legend(loc='lower right'); ax.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.25)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('chart4_dis_inflation.png', dpi=150); plt.close()

print("Charts saved.")
import os
for f in os.listdir('.'):
    if f.endswith('.png'): print(f, os.path.getsize(f), 'bytes')
